data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2037 in Cabopino promises a spectacular fireworks display over the Mediterranean. The best seat in the house isn't on the beach — it's on the water. With a Cabopino boat rental New Year's Eve 2037 fireworks charter, you skip the crowds, enjoy unlimited drinks, and watch the sky explode from your private yacht. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, just 10 minutes from Cabopino. Prices start at €749 for two hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including skipper, fuel, and a fully stocked bar. For larger groups, yachts like the Mangusta 80 (12 guests) or Ferretti 94 (12 guests) offer more space and luxury. Book early — NYE slots fill fast.

Why Choose a Boat for Cabopino NYE Fireworks?

Watching fireworks from the shore means fighting for a spot, dealing with cold wind, and queuing for drinks. On a private boat, you get: an uninterrupted view of the display over the sea, a heated cabin or flybridge if it gets chilly, your own bar with cava, beer, and wine, and a licensed skipper who handles everything. The fireworks at Cabopino are launched from the beach, so being 100–200 metres offshore gives you a perfect angle. Plus, you can cruise along the coast before the show — past Marbella's Golden Mile and Puerto Banús — and return after midnight without traffic jams.

Our Fleet for NYE 2037

We offer a range of boats to suit different group sizes and budgets. All depart from Puerto Banús, a 10-minute cruise to Cabopino. Here's a quick overview:

What's Included in Every Charter

No hidden costs. Every booking includes: licensed skipper (speaks English and Spanish), fuel for the entire trip, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, light snacks (chips, nuts, olives), insurance and safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). You can bring your own food, decorations, or a birthday cake. Just let us know in advance if you need a cooler or extra table space.

How to Book Your NYE 2037 Charter

Booking is simple. For boats with fixed prices (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, Mangusta 80), you can reserve directly on our site. For all other yachts (Ferretti 94, K80, Maiora 26m, etc.), pricing is on request — message us on WhatsApp for a custom quote. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance for NYE. A 50% deposit secures the date, with the balance due 7 days before departure. Cancel up to 14 days before for a full refund.

Sample NYE Itinerary

Here's a typical 4-hour evening charter: 21:00 — Board at Puerto Banús, welcome cava. 21:30 — Cruise east towards Cabopino, passing Marbella's illuminated coastline. 22:30 — Anchor off Cabopino beach, enjoy snacks and drinks. 23:55 — Countdown and fireworks display. 00:30 — Return cruise to Puerto Banús with music. 01:00 — Disembark. For a longer evening, add a sunset cruise from 19:00 or extend to 8 hours with a dinner stop at a beach club like Cabopino's Chiringuito.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where do the boats leave from for Cabopino fireworks?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, which is about 10 minutes by sea from Cabopino. The captain will navigate to a prime position off Cabopino beach for the fireworks display.

How many people can I bring on a boat for NYE 2037?

Our smallest boat (Dubhe) takes 5 guests, while larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or K80 accommodate up to 12. For bigger groups, you can charter multiple boats.

What is included in the price?

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden extras.

Can we bring our own food and decorations?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food, decorations, and party supplies. The boats have coolers and table space. Just avoid glass bottles for safety.

How far in advance should I book for NYE 2037?

We recommend booking at least 2–3 months ahead. Popular boats like the Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 Flybridge get reserved early for New Year's Eve.

What happens if the weather is bad on NYE?

Your safety is paramount. If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we will reschedule or issue a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely.

Is there a minimum booking duration for NYE?

For the fireworks show, a 2-hour charter is enough to get into position and watch the display. Many guests book 4 hours to enjoy sunset cruising first.

Can we anchor and watch the fireworks from the boat?

Absolutely. The captain will anchor the boat at a safe distance from other vessels, giving you an unobstructed view of the Cabopino fireworks.
